description: d_min=0.08 -- late-time production (months 48-60) averages ~95 bbl with very slow decline, flatter than 5% exponential. Raising d_min from 0.05 to 0.08 to better capture terminal decline flattening
qi_guess_strategy=max3 -- early production is noisy (month 1: 1098, month 4: 959, month 6: 807) so averaging top 3 months may give a better qi initial guess than using just the first month

outlier_threshold=0.20 -- operational dips at months 11 (245 bbl, 54% drop), 19 (199 bbl), 47 (87 bbl) are included in fit with 0% outlier rejection. Lowering threshold from 0.30 to 0.20 to remove these curtailment artifacts

b_initial=1.0 -- fitted b=0.57 may understate late-time flattening. Production months 49-60 decline only ~15% (98 to 87 bbl), suggesting stronger hyperbolic character. Higher b_initial may steer optimizer to a solution with slower late-time decline

smoothing_window=5 -- wider smoothing may shift the decline anchor point, changing the fit window and producing different qi/di/b. Current fit gives identical results regardless of initial guesses, suggesting the decline anchor needs to change

significance_threshold=0.30 -- lowers peak significance cutoff from 549 to 329 bbl, allowing later peaks (e.g. month 18 at 416 bbl) to qualify as most recent significant peak, shifting decline anchor away from month 0

d_min=0.08 -- with new anchor (b=0.24, near-exponential), decline rate drops fast. Late-time production (months 55-60: 99-87 bbl) shows flattening that d_min=0.05 may underpredict. Raising to 0.08 to set a higher terminal decline floor

peak_merge_distance=6 -- with threshold=0.30, peaks in months 12-18 range may be merging suboptimally. Wider merge distance (6 vs 3) combines nearby peaks into single groups, potentially selecting a different representative peak as the decline anchor

qi_guess_strategy=peak_value -- with the 48-month fit window starting at a mid-production peak, using the actual peak value as qi guess (rather than first month of trimmed data) may steer the optimizer to a better local minimum

qi_multiplier_upper=10.0 -- with the later decline anchor (qi_guess ~400 bbl), the upper qi bound is only 2000 bbl. Doubling multiplier from 5.0 to 10.0 allows optimizer to explore higher qi values with steeper initial decline to better match holdout
